subject.title: [Feature]: Support arbitrary workspace files in bootstrap context injection

question: Should OpenClaw support arbitrary explicitly configured workspace bootstrap files in core, and should the accepted contract be a narrow expansion of existing `bootstrap-extra-files.paths` or the broader session-scoped contract in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/74735?
rationale: Current main still has the reported limitation, but changing what files can enter bootstrap context is a prompt/session-state and config-contract decision under the repository policy.

options.title: Review linked PR as canonical fix
options.body: Keep this issue open and decide whether https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/74735 is the right implementation after resolving its conflict and upgrade concerns.

options.title: Request narrower hook-only fix
options.body: Ask for a smaller PR that permits arbitrary explicit `paths` entries while preserving existing filtering, guards, budgets, and docs.

options.title: Decline core expansion
options.body: Close only after maintainers decide custom workspace context should remain convention or plugin guidance rather than core bootstrap behavior.

recommendation.title: Review linked PR as canonical fix
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and decide whether https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/74735 is the right implementation after resolving its conflict and upgrade concerns.

likelyOwner.reason: He merged the original hook work and recently maintained the hook/docs/bootstrap safety path.
